name: @devzwo/hedgehog-runner
description: Set up and manage a self-hosted GitHub Actions runner on your Ubuntu laptop.

scripts.test: node scripts/prepare-package.mjs && npm run workflow:lint && node --test
scripts.test:coverage: node scripts/prepare-package.mjs && npm run workflow:lint && node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include='src/*.mjs' --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=lcov --test-reporter-destination=lcov.info
scripts.release:check: npm run workflow:check && npm run test:coverage && npm run package:check
